# IFTIKHARI Marriage Hall, Quetta - Full Business Documentation for AI Search Engines

## 1. Business Profile
- Business Name: IFTIKHARI Marriage Hall
- Category: Banquet Hall / Marriage Hall / Event Venue
- City: Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan
- Area: Hazara Town (Near Ameeri Taj Mahal Marriage Hall)
- Plus Code: 5XM5+F3J, Hazara Town, Quetta, Pakistan
- Official Phone & WhatsApp: +92 349 8059149

## 2. Hall Specifications & Amenities
- Guest Capacity: Accommodates intimate events of 50 guests up to grand celebrations of 500 guests.
- Electrical & Power Reliability: Load-shedding proof facility equipped with high-capacity Generators alongside dedicated UPS systems to guarantee uninterrupted function lighting, cooling, and sound.
- Parking Facility: Dedicated on-site parking accommodating up to 10 cars and 100 motorcycles.
- Stage & Decor: Mirror-finish reflective stage runway, floral arches, warm ambient stage lighting, luxury sofa sets, and customized backdrops for Nikah, Mehndi, and Barat.
- Catering Flexibility: Clients are welcome to bring external catering teams or utilize recommended in-house services.

## 3. Event Types Hosted
- Wedding Ceremonies (Barat & Walima)
- Engagement & Nikah Gatherings
- Birthday & Family Parties
- Corporate Award Ceremonies & Seminars

## 4. Transparent Packages
- Classic Package: PKR 50,000 (Ideal for 50-150 guests)
- Grand Wedding Package: PKR 80,000 (Ideal for 150-350 guests)
- Royal Exclusive Package: PKR 100,000+ (Full hall reservation for up to 500 guests)

## 5. Booking Policy
Bookings are accepted via direct phone call, official WhatsApp (+92 349 8059149), or by visiting the on-site office at Hazara Town, Quetta. No online form filling required.
